content: React Three Fiber wraps three.js as a React reconciler, abstracting scene, camera, renderer, and render-loop setup into declarative JSX components; R3F only makes sense inside a React project and only if declarative abstraction is wanted. Vanilla three.js requires imperative object creation, explicit scene graph management, and a manual animation loop, the exact mechanics this projects stated core value wants learned firsthand. R3F wraps three.js rather than replacing it; excluding it for v1 is consistent with the projects own PROJECT.md decision.
